description: A power strip is lying on the bed in front of you, with a black power cord plugged into one of its outlets and looping across the sheet. The left hand stays on the power strip to steady it while the right hand reaches in, grips the plug, pulls it upward to remove it from the socket, then brings the plug back down and pushes it into an outlet again; throughout, the power strip is a left-hand object and the plug and cord are a right-hand object.
